body:
Renamed from `chip-rtl-loop`, whose slug landed in parallel (#284). This project is a companion with a different task suite (12 tasks) and a mutation probe of the three checker stages.

- Session-written attempts (one per task, not an LLM benchmark) all passed at round 0.
- 414 single-point mutants: 30 of 389 rejected ones are caught only by the formal stage.
- Post-hoc lint relaxation (WIDTH, UNOPTFLAT) is disclosed in the README.
- 9 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
